name: Amon
summary: A son of Manasseh who became king of Judah at twenty-two and reigned two years in Jerusalem. He served his father's idols, and his own servants killed him in his house.

key_moments.title: Serves His Father's Idols
key_moments.description: Amon did evil as his father Manasseh had, sacrificing to all the carved images his father made. He did not humble himself before the LORD as Manasseh had, but sinned more and more.

key_moments.title: Killed by His Own Servants
key_moments.description: Amon's servants plotted against him and killed him in his own house. The people of the land killed the plotters and made his son Josiah king.
